_purpose: The canonical loop state machine as DATA. Before this file, scripts/check_transition_ledger.py enforced CONTINUITY -- each transition's from_state equalled the subject's previous to_state -- and never LEGALITY. A ledger recording DETECTED -> EFFECTIVE, skipping eleven states including every verification and authority gate, was accepted. Demonstrated, not theorised: the check ran and exited 0. CONTINUOUS != LEGAL.
_quarantine_note: QUARANTINED is reachable from any state, because framework integrity can become uncertain at any point and containment must never be an illegal move. It is declared as a flag rather than as thirty edges so the exception is visible instead of buried in the edge list.
_repair_note: Repair edges return to a state that REDOES the work. VERIFICATION_FAILED -> EXECUTING, never -> VERIFYING: re-verifying an unchanged candidate and reporting the second look as a result is how a retry launders a failure into a pass.
_reopen_note: Reopening is DECLARED and justified, never justified alone. A justification that could make any edge legal would turn the state machine into a suggestion. Only three terminal states are reopenable: CLOSED (the reconciler's FALSE_CLOSURE class exists precisely because closure can be wrong), QUARANTINED (containment is meant to be liftable) and ROLLED_BACK (a rollback is followed by re-planning). DUPLICATE, SUPERSEDED and OUTSIDE_MANDATE are NOT reopenable: the right move there is a new subject, not the resurrection of a settled one.
